report.notes: Applied a light palette, blue mail controls, rounded panels, and translucent chrome. The site checker passed; substantial visual differences remain.

differences: Overall layout: the rendered mail app is a small floating card surrounded by broad gray margins at 1536x864; the design fills the screen below its title banner.
Top frame: the mountain photograph, large Mail title, bell and profile buttons are replaced by a flat gradient episode bar and a compact internal toolbar.
Reading pane: the design displays a selected message with subject, sender avatar, divider and body; the page shows an empty envelope placeholder with no highlighted message.
Action toolbar: the large Inbox heading, unread summary, Reply, Reply All, Forward, archive, delete, tag and overflow controls are missing.

Sidebar and message list: text, icons and controls are substantially smaller and denser; Compose and search move into the top toolbar, folder icons become colored initials, and stars move from the right of message rows to the left.
Bottom frame: the design's full-width Mail, Calendar, Contacts and Files navigation is absent, replaced by a narrow storage meter and an external footer.
frame_issues: Header, side-panel and notification settings all display the instruction in the same top gradient bar; the panel and notification presentations are absent.
